title: mosla punctata
intro: Mosla punctata, commonly known as Chinese Chrysanthemum Bitters, is a type of plant in the Lamiaceae family, native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to alleviate fever, reduce inflammation, and treat digestive issues. Mosla punctata's therapeutic actions are attributed to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and carminative properties, which make it a popular remedy in traditional Chinese medicine. The bioactive constituents of Mosla punctata include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
